## Purpose and Entry Points
This Terraform module provisions Google Cloud Access Context Manager and VPC Service Controls (VPC-SC). The root module creates an Access Context Manager access policy; consumers compose it with submodules for access levels and service perimeters. Primary entry files: `main.tf`, `variables.tf`, `outputs.tf`, `versions.tf`.

## Root Access Policy
The root resource accepts an organization parent, policy name, and optional folder/project scopes, then exposes the policy ID/name for downstream modules. This is the control-plane anchor for all VPC-SC configuration: `main.tf`, `variables.tf`, `outputs.tf`.

## Access-Level Stage
The access-level module defines Access Context Manager access levels, including member/IP-based policy inputs, under the root policy. Its outputs supply access-level names to regular perimeters: `modules/access_level/main.tf`, `modules/access_level/variables.tf`, `modules/access_level/outputs.tf`.

## Regular Service Perimeters
The regular-perimeter module creates protected resource boundaries with projects/resources, restricted Google APIs, access levels, shared resources, and ingress/egress policy controls. It may manage scoped policy behavior separately from core perimeter configuration: `modules/regular_service_perimeter/main.tf`, `modules/regular_service_perimeter/vpc-sc-policies.tf`, `modules/regular_service_perimeter/variables.tf`.

## Bridge Service Perimeters
Bridge perimeters connect otherwise isolated service perimeters without providing the full restriction model of a regular perimeter. They share the root policy boundary but are configured independently: `modules/bridge_service_perimeter/main.tf`, `modules/bridge_service_perimeter/variables.tf`, `modules/bridge_service_perimeter/outputs.tf`.

## Composition and Control Flow
A Terraform consumer first applies the root access policy, passes `policy_id` to access-level, regular-perimeter, and bridge-perimeter modules, then passes generated access-level identifiers into regular perimeter rules. Terraform builds the dependency graph from these module outputs and resource references. Representative end-to-end compositions are in `examples/simple_example/main.tf`, `examples/simple_example_bridge/main.tf`, and `examples/scoped_example_with_egress_rule/main.tf`.

## Runtime, APIs, and Operational Boundary
Runtime is Terraform 1.3+ with the Google provider; managed external control planes are Google Cloud Access Context Manager and VPC Service Controls. Execution requires organization-level Access Context Manager administration and enabled Access Context Manager API. API propagation is eventually consistent—initial perimeter-related applies can fail until prior policy changes take effect, so deployments may need a delayed/retried apply. Version/provider constraints are centralized in `versions.tf` and module-level `modules/*/versions.tf`.

## Verification and Delivery
Integration coverage uses Go-based discovery plus InSpec/gcloud controls against deployed example fixtures, establishing that this repository validates real Google Cloud state rather than only static plans: `test/integration/discover_test.go`, `test/integration/simple_example/controls/gcloud.rb`, `test/setup/main.tf`. Cloud Build definitions provide CI build/lint execution: `build/int.cloudbuild.yaml`, `build/lint.cloudbuild.yaml`.
